name: Hungaroring (Grand Prix)

career.layoutCall: Grand Prix circuit (4.381 km): Euroformula Open, June 2023. 2024-26 rebuilds of the pit building, paddock and grandstands and 2025-26 resurfacing changed no corner (research notes table). OSM's other loop runs down 'Bokszutca' (the pit lane), drawn here as the pit.

meta.heightsNote: OSM height or building:levels x 3.4 m + 1 m where tagged (real: true); otherwise defaults, not data: 6 m buildings, 8 m grandstands, 4 m bleachers; Overture footprints 6 m
meta.treesNote: trees from OSM woods (one per 9 m), tree rows and single trees, and ESA WorldCover tree cover (one per 10 m cell) where OSM has no wood; positions jittered up to 3-4 m by a fixed hash; none drawn by hand

circuit.startFinishNote: start/finish at an approximate point: beside the middle of the pit lane (OSM way 231417580, its 1070 m along the loop); OSM has no start/finish node here and no official map was checked

model.pitNote: OSM way 231417580 ("bokszutca"), 1069 m, nearest the start/finish (14 m)
